question: Does the fixed divider retain static voltage margin with a real resistor family and temperature drift?
method: Initial tolerance plus independent TCR and two manufacturer load-life comparison envelopes; no waveform simulation
stop_condition: Evaluate fresh and 8000 h general-mode comparison once; keep values fixed and record residual unallocated error
limits: Temperature range is a design comparison, not measured board temperature
8000 h rating condition is not a user lifetime requirement or an assembled-board lifetime guarantee
Bias-current test-point limitation from detector review remains
